statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis is consistent with code I25.10
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The claim was denied with denial reason code CO-50
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes in the context of established coronary artery disease
